6:107.text: But if Allāh had willed, they would not have associated. And We have not appointed you over them as a guardian, nor are you a manager over them.

6:108.text: And do not insult those they invoke other than Allāh, lest they insult Allāh in enmity without knowledge. Thus We have made pleasing to every community their deeds. Then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them about what they used to do.
